move: tab indicator slides with stretch, icon pops, page crossfades per tap
how: A phone mock with a white bottom tab bar holding a blue rounded indicator behind four icon tabs, and four stacked page mocks. Cursor arrives in the first 12% of the 5s loop. On each tap (1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.1s) the indicator translates one tab width with expo.out over 0.5s while stretching scaleX 1.25 and relaxing with elastic.out(1,0.45); the outgoing tab greys and its label fades, the incoming tab turns white, its label rises in (y 6 to 0, power3.out) and its icon hops up 6px at scale 1.15 then settles with elastic.out(1,0.4). The current page fades and slides 24px against the travel direction with power2.in while the next page enters from 40px with expo.out. The cursor moves ahead with power2.inOut and dips scale 0.85 on click. The last tap returns to Home so the loop closes.
adapt: Change the four tab icons and labels, page mock contents, the blue indicator and phone frame; tab width W is measured so counts other than four work if the tap schedule is adjusted. Keep expo.out 0.5s slides with the scaleX stretch.
port: mount(el, shot) builds phone, pages, tabbar with indicator, tabs and cursor inside el, measuring W from the first tab after layout. animate returns the timeline with taps at 0.2D, 0.4D, 0.6D and 0.82D. Scope all selectors to el; cy/cx0 derive from the 340x680 phone constants and should be computed from the tab bar offset.
caveats: tab width measured from offsetWidth at build time
